people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

people.name: Phinehas
people.line: Aaron's grandson; zealous priest who opposed idolatry

translations.web: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.
translations.bsb: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers, and the LORD was with him.
translations.kjv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.
translations.asv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Jehovah was with him.
